item.title: Community leaders urge voters to research ballot initiatives ahead of 2026
item.description: Community leaders held a forum urging rural voters to research ballot initiatives ahead of 2026 midterms, emphasizing the importance of understanding complex ballot language.

item.title: FAMU honors African American military service with new exhibition for America 250 & Black History Month
item.description: The exhibit is inside the Meek-Eaton Black Archives and features materials from the Meek-Eaton African American Military Collection and private family donations.

item.title: Madison County school board delays personnel decisions amid state transportation investigation
item.description: The Madison County School Board postponed personnel decisions Thursday as the Florida DOE investigates transportation compliance issues, including untrained driver allegations.
